<h1 class="uk-h6 uk-margin-remove-vertical uk-text-left@s uk-text-center">
                    Tarifa Kite Hostel        
</h1>
<h1 class="uk-heading-medium uk-margin-remove-vertical uk-text-left@s uk-text-center">
                    On the<span class="uk-text-secondary"> road</span>        
</h1><div class="uk-panel uk-margin uk-text-left@s uk-text-center" id="page#1"><p>We like to travel and we like to attend to the needs of other travellers. Our Hostel is made with a lot of love <strong>thinking about people who love sports and the beach</strong>.</p>
<p>Located in the south of Spain, in the town of Tarifa, 5 minutes walk from long unspoilt beaches<strong>: an amazing place to enjoy great beaches, sports and glorious sunsets.</strong></p>
<p>Many of our guests came for a week but have decided to stay with us for a lifetime. Instead of guests we now consider them <strong>FAMILY.</strong></p></div>

                    HOME

<div class="uk-width-3-4@m">
<div class="uk-h3 uk-margin uk-text-left@s uk-text-center">
                    <span class="uk-text-secondary">Tarifa Kite</span> Hostel consists of a lovingly renovated building where guests and water sports enthusiasts can feel at home.        
</div><div class="uk-panel uk-margin uk-text-left@s uk-text-center"><p>We offer a large and well-equipped kitchen, generously sized common areas, a cosy living room with fireplace for chilly days, free Wi-Fi throughout the house and two terraces with magnificent views of the Strait of Gibraltar. Our garden is one of the most beautiful in Tarifa. We have an outdoor bar and chill-out area, a barbecue area, comfortable deckchairs and plenty of good vibes.</p></div>
